A club outcome rate, not his answer key.
step_2_april_approach: If re-signed: Jacksonville requests permission on February 3. step_3_westhoff: Reached only if April is not hired. Contact February 5. If willing: interview February 10, offer February 11, accepted. If not: he declines on February 7.
step_4_dehaven: Reached only if Westhoff declines. Request to Carolina February 10. Coordinator is a step up in title from assistant, so the symmetric default policy grants it on February 11; interview February 12; offer February 13, accepted (Entry 75 stage 5).
salary: Every offer opens at the candidate's opening figure. A counter is drawn with probability 0.5 (labelled modelling choice, no source); a counter is met at the authorized ceiling, which Stone's instruction already authorizes. Nothing above a ceiling or outside the common terms is offered.
funding: Document 3 section 3.1 promises Stone a funded assistant budget consistent with his proposed staff, with no numeric ceiling. His proposed staff included a special teams coordinator at $625,000. The branch treats a like-for-like replacement within the plan's ceilings (at most $7,750,000 total, 2.3 percent above the original $7,575,000) as within that promise; Caldwell confirms the allocation before the offer. exhaustion: If all three fail, the job stays vacant, Stone keeps interim direction and the next choice returns to the user.
draws: One private packet (method, script and snapshot digests). One seeded generator draws in fixed order: April employment, April salary counter, Westhoff willingness, Westhoff salary counter, DeHaven salary counter, whatever the path.
